assessments.reasoning: An otherwise valid declaration marks the method name DEF_NONLOCAL. The extended class-analysis range shows the decisive operation missing from the proposal. The class adds __class__ to the bound set supplied to its children even when there is no inherited binding. In the method, membership in that set and absence from the type-parameter set lead to FREE classification.

challenge.method: Trace the pinned symbol-table branches for a direct method in a module-level class, first with __class__ and then with a name supplied only by an ordinary class assignment.
challenge.results: Only the special name receives the implicit binding in this comparison. The ordinary attribute cannot satisfy the method's nonlocal check. This is a static trace of CPython 3.13.0 and establishes symbol classification only.

limitations: This records the pinned implementation's symbol-table classification. It does not generalize it to arbitrary classes, runtime cell customization, or other Python implementations.

The reproduction used the Python Software Foundation Windows AMD64 release build. It concerns the direct ordinary-method symbol classification and does not claim language-wide portability or behavior of customized class cells.
